# Dependency-Track API

9 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/admin/dependency-track`

Get the global Dependency-Track settings

Admin only. The API key is never returned.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Success | `application/json`: [DependencyTrackSettings](schemas.md#dependencytracksettings) |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `PUT /api/v1/admin/dependency-track`

Replace the global Dependency-Track settings

Admin only. Replaces the non-secret fields; `api_key` is write-only (omitted keeps it, empty clears it). Enabling needs a base URL and an API key. The URL must pass the outbound SSRF check. Project name and version are templates over `{repo}`, `{name}`, `{version}`, `{artifact_id}` and `{format}`.

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api_key` | string | no | Plaintext API key. Omit to keep the stored one, empty string clears it. |
| `auto_push` | boolean | no | - |
| `base_url` | string | no | - |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes | - |
| `project_name` | string | no | - |
| `project_version` | string | no | - |
| `push_vex` | boolean | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Success | `application/json`: [DependencyTrackSettings](schemas.md#dependencytracksettings) |
| `400` | Validation failed | - |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/admin/dependency-track/test`

Test the global Dependency-Track connection

Admin only. Calls the server with the stored URL and key and reports its version and the API key's permissions against the ones the integration needs.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Success | `application/json`: [DependencyTrackTest](schemas.md#dependencytracktest) |
| `400` | Not configured, unreachable or key rejected | - |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/dependency-track`

Get a repository's Dependency-Track settings

Admin only. Returns the repository override (null when none) and the effective configuration.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Success | `application/json`: [DependencyTrackRepository](schemas.md#dependencytrackrepository) |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `PUT /api/v1/repositories/{name}/dependency-track`

Set a repository's Dependency-Track override

Admin only. Empty strings and null booleans inherit the global settings.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api_key` | string | no | Plaintext API key. Omit to keep the stored one, empty string clears it. |
| `auto_push` | boolean | no | Nullable. |
| `base_url` | string | no | - |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes | false opts the repository out even when the global integration is on. |
| `project_name` | string | no | - |
| `project_version` | string | no | - |
| `push_vex` | boolean | no | Nullable. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Success | `application/json`: [DependencyTrackRepository](schemas.md#dependencytrackrepository) |
| `400` | Validation failed | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `DELETE /api/v1/repositories/{name}/dependency-track`

Remove a repository's Dependency-Track override

Admin only. The repository falls back to the global settings.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Removed | - |
| `404` | Repository or override not found | - |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/dependency-track/push`

Push an artifact to Dependency-Track

Admin only. Queues the push of the artifact's CycloneDX BOM and, when `push_vex` is on, its VEX decisions; poll `/pushes` for the outcome.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact_id` | string | yes | `name@version` |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | Queued | `application/json`: [DependencyTrackPush](schemas.md#dependencytrackpush) |
| `400` | Validation failed | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `409` | Integration not enabled for the repository, or queue full | - |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/dependency-track/pushes`

List Dependency-Track pushes

Admin only. The last push of each artifact, newest first.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Success | `application/json`: object |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pushes` | array of [DependencyTrackPush](schemas.md#dependencytrackpush) | no | - |
